coin.title: Malta 10 euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike PL70
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=C3RPAEG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A perfect Malta 10 euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike? PL70 coins are absolutely perfect with deep mirror-like brilliance. They reflect expert craftsmanship and flawless preservation. This coin is a crown jewel for any prooflike coin enthusiast. Only 7 pieces are available! Design The Malta 10 Euro 2024 ‘Karnival ta’ Malta’ Silver Prooflike is a special issue with a colored detail. On the obverse of the coin, an animated figure looks up, arms spread out. On the head is a mask, that is a referral to the use of masks during the Malta Carnival. The background consists of a Mandala-pattern: this is specially colored in rainbow colors, which makes the coin even more unique. On the bottom of the coin is the text ’10 Euro Karnival ta’ Malta’. On the reverse is the logo of the Central Bank of Malta.
